Saturday 3 May

The old greenhouse
Everything grown here, from seed, without peat.

A summer of pressing
plants and printing them in sun.
Six plants from the verge behind the allotments, printed on paper coated by hand.
Dry the plant flat between paper for a week.
Brush the paper in the dark. Let it dry in the dark.
Lay the plant on the paper under glass. Ten minutes of sun.
Wash in cold water until the white turns clear. It deepens as it dries.
